title: feat: auto-merge actions into object metadata via objectName
body:
Top-level `actions` in `defineStack()` are not associated with objects, so `metadata.getObject` returns objects without actions. Downstream consumers (Console, Studio, ActionBar) all depend on `objectDef.actions` and must manually merge — breaking the Salesforce/ServiceNow convention where actions are part of the object schema.

### Changes

- **`ActionSchema`** — added optional `objectName` field (snake_case validated) to declare object association
- **`ObjectSchema`** — added optional `actions` array field to hold object-scoped actions
- **`defineStack()`** — post-parse merge step injects actions with `objectName` into their target object's `actions` array; runs in both strict and non-strict modes
- **`composeStacks()`** — applies same merge for cross-stack action→object references
- **Cross-reference validation** — `action.objectName` referencing an undefined object now produces a validation error (consistent with existing workflow/hook/view validation)
- **Example apps updated** — all action definitions in `app-todo` and `app-crm` (lead, opportunity, case, contact) now include `objectName`; global actions (`log_call`, `export_csv`) intentionally remain without `objectName` as platform-wide action examples

Top-level `actions` array is preserved for global access (platform overview, search).

### Usage

```ts
const stack = defineStack({
  objects: [
    { name: 'deal', fields: { amount: { type: 'number' } } },
  ],
  actions: [
    { name: 'close_deal', label: 'Close Deal', objectName: 'deal' },
    { name: 'global_search', label: 'Search' }, // no objectName → global only
  ],
});

// stack.objects[0].actions → [{ name: 'close_deal', ... }]
// stack.actions → both actions still present
```

Actions defined inline on the object are preserved; merged actions are appended after them.

### End-to-End Flow

- **Metadata API** (`/api/v1/meta/objects/:name`) returns the full `ObjectSchema` without field filtering — `actions` field is included automatically
- **ObjectQL engine** stores the full object definition during registration — `actions` preserved through the pipeline
- **No downstream changes needed** — Console, Studio, and custom UIs receive actions as part of `objectDef.actions`

> <issue_title>AppPlugin自动合并actions到object元数据，以便API返回的对象自带actions字段</issue_title>
> <issue_description>### 问题描述
> 当前actions是以顶层数组（defineStack({ actions:[...] })）独立声明，并未自动合并/挂载到相应object中，导致API如 /api/v1/meta/objects/:name 返回的对象没有actions。Console及Studio上的所有ActionBar、ActionButton等均依赖objectDef.actions，所以下游全部失效。
> 
> ### 预期行为
> - AppPlugin在加载/注册栈(config)时，自动将actions归类（按objectName、前缀、或新设计的关联字段）合并到对应object的`actions`属性中
> - `metadata.getObject` 接口返回的object必须包含actions（兼容主流企业平台如ServiceNow/Salesforce/APPEX等，actions必须是对象schema字段一部分）
> - 任何下游消费端（Console/Studio/自定义UI）都无需手动merge
> 
> ### 参考
> - Salesforce: CustomActions 配置直接嵌入object，API响应天然包含action列表
> - HotCRM plugin/定义已建议插��独立出口object及actions，无需外部merge
> 
> ### 实现建议
> - AppPlugin初始化时，遍历actions数组，依照objectName或命名规范自动注入对象
> - 如无法确定归属可加warning
> - 保留单独actions API，供特殊场景（如平台总览、全局搜索）用
> 
> ### 价值
> - 一致兼容所有使用场景，无需每个消费端各自patch/merge
> - 明确与国际主流平台的对齐
> - 减少未来低代码/设计器及runtime二次开发门槛
>
